conbody.p: Unable to establish a connection between the and the Wi-Fi network generated by an or unable to establish a connection between an and the plant’s Wi-Fi network.
The connection issue could be due to several reasons such as:

ul.li: the client’s AP is turned off
the SSID/Wi-Fi network name or password has changed

ol.li: After the five minutes have elapsed, remove the batteries from the to avoid draining them.
Make sure the plant’s internet connection is in a working state.
Re-insert the batteries and try the connection process again.
